_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 3% coil frequency over 7 days means no statistically visible breaker exists, and the analyst's divergent factors (ETF flows, MVRV, stablecoins) actively argue against the bullish analog that would justify an UP call.
next_move.brains_agree: No — the analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction while the narrative writer leans toward an upside mean-reversion squeeze; the split reflects the analyst's factor divergences overriding the narrative's pattern trust.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows recover above 30 AND MVRV Z-score climbs above 30 with funding staying below 0.02%
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 25 with DXY breaking 103 and BTC funding flipping negative — would signal leg down to Anxiety
